annotations.title: Prepare a Bridge to Earn task

description: Prepares one open Bridge to Earn task for an address, from OrbitWan's own reads: the address's WAN and the WAN pledge on Wanchain, the claimTask call with our node's eth_call of it from the address, the address's task token and native balance on the source chain, the XFlows quote and request body, every funding requirement with have, need and short, ready, and the reward's options in WAN. With source_tx and signature it also builds the claimReward call and its eth_call. Copy figures and calldata exactly as returned; a null is unknown, never zero. The wanchain-bridge-to-earn skill gives the full workflow.
name: prepare_bridge_to_earn
title: Prepare a Bridge to Earn task
